---
title: "Ribasim-NL"
subtitle: "A nationwide water model of the Netherlands, built from source data by a reproducible pipeline"
toc: false
---

Ribasim-NL builds the Dutch national water model LHM with [Ribasim](https://ribasim.org/), a water resources model.
It combines a model of the main water system of Rijkswaterstaat with the regional models of 21 water authorities, from their source data, into one model of about 20 000 Basins.
A [DVC](https://dvc.org/) pipeline in this repository makes every step reproducible, so a change to the data or the code gives a new model that can be compared with the previous one.

## From source data to a nationwide model

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  rws["Rijkswaterstaat data<br>bathymetry, structures"] --> hws["Main water system<br>model"]
  sweco["Watercourses, structures<br>11 water authorities"] --> gravity["Gravity controlled<br>regional models"]
  hkv["Level areas, structures<br>10 water authorities"] --> level["Level controlled<br>regional models"]
  forcing["LHM forcing, foreign inflows,<br>wastewater, target levels"] --> gravity
  forcing --> level
  forcing --> hws
  hws --> coupled["Merged and coupled<br>LHM"]
  gravity --> coupled
  level --> coupled
  coupled --> run["Model run"]
  run --> check["Checks and metrics"]
  run --> viewer["Model viewer"]

  classDef model fill:#dfedef,stroke:#0c6a77
  class hws,gravity,level,coupled model
```

[Model derivation](workflow/index.qmd) explains each step, with maps of real examples.
